remarks: Charming 2 (or possibly 3) Bedroom Cape With Skylights And Vaulted Ceiling in An Oversized Eat In Kitchen. Hardwood Floors, Living Room With Fireplace And Potential In-Law In Lower Level (Sep Entrance). Located Near End Of Woodward. Extra room on upper level currently being used as a large walk-in closet. Rear deck off kitchen has a roof and temporary siding (a makeshift additional storage room for seller). Patio in private fenced backyard. 300 feet away from Woodward Park - a 4.2 acre public park that includes childrens playground, athletic field, ballpark, tennis courts, pickleball courts, basketball court, open fields for picnics, walking path, on-site restroom and water access available.  More info online at: https://www.norwalkct.gov/3319/Woodward-Park
